## NOO-21 — 718 Webster St, Oakland (APN 001 018701000)

**Verdict:** likely_occupied (0.78 confidence), based on current evidence of a Labcorp patient service center at Suite 101. This supports occupied commercial use in at least part of the parcel, not occupancy of every unit or the whole building.

**Vacancy start/duration:** Not established. The Sep 2020 fire caused temporary boarding, but the available sources do not date reopening or show a continuous vacant period through the present. No supported vacancy interval can be assigned.

**Evidence checked (observed 2026-10-15):**
- Labcorp's official page names 718 Webster St, Suite 101, Oakland, CA 94607; lists routine lab work and walk-ins; and displays hours for the current week including Oct 15, 2026: https://locations.labcorp.com/ca/oakland/53662/
- Eater's Sep 17, 2020 reporting describes the Sep 16 five-alarm fire, restaurants damaged, and the building boarded up after the fire; owners expected rebuilding could take six months to a year. It does not establish present condition or reopening date: https://sf.eater.com/2020/9/17/21444041/rang-dong-huangcheng-noodle-house-oakland-chinatown-fire-closed
- Oakland city planning attachment maps the street address to APN 001 018701000: https://oakland.legistar.com/View.ashx?GUID=DE9D9D0B-4771-4D9D-8F7E-B529062A531F&ID=15191265&M=F

No reliable public evidence found here establishing an ongoing vacancy period.
